assert c['status']=='proposed' and type(c['approvals']['revisions']) is int and c['approvals']['revisions']==2

for p in ['.agent/contracts/117.json','.agent/evidence/117/api-interface.json']:
 blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',proposal+':'+p]); assert blob==(r/p).read_bytes(); print('FROZEN_PROPOSAL',p,hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest())
feature=next(x for x in f['features'] if x['id']=='117')
assert feature['acceptance_tests']==[x['command'] for x in c['verification'][:4]]

assert s['circuit_breaker']['117-recovery1-contract-review']=={'attempts':0,'limit':3}

authpath=c['entry_authority']['authorization_path']; auth=read(authpath)
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','show',c['entry_authority']['authorization_revision']+':'+authpath])==(r/authpath).read_bytes()
print('LOCAL_AUTHORITY',json.dumps(auth,sort_keys=True))
pin=c['entry_authority']['installed_pin']; assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',pin['tag']+'^{commit}'],text=True).strip()==pin['resolved_sha']

 assert subprocess.check_output(['git','show',pin['resolved_sha']+':'+p])==(r/'.nizam'/p).read_bytes(); print('CRITICAL_INSTALLED_MATCH',p)
for g in c['entry_write_grants']:
 assert set(g)=={'role','profile','path','fields','operation','full_file','create_only'}
 assert type(g['full_file']) is bool and type(g['create_only']) is bool
 assert (g['role'],g['profile']) in [('Orchestrator','orchestrator-primary'),('Planner','planner-creative'),('Generator','generator-deterministic'),('Validator','validator-structural'),('Evaluator','evaluator-adversarial')]
assert any(g['role']=='Evaluator' and g['path']=='tools/test_workflow_assurance.py' and g['full_file'] for g in c['entry_write_grants'])
